'''Yumi Tsukirino''' (Japanese: '''月梨野 ゆみ''') is a {{wp|mangaka|manga author}} of the {{pkmn|manga}} series [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] and [[Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪]]. Her birthday is January 5, 1950, her {{wp|blood type}} is O and her hobbies include watching horse racing. Some of her favorite Pokémon are {{p|Arbok}} and {{p|Sandslash}}. 

Before and during her work on the Magical Pokémon Journey manga, Tsukirino started playing the [[Pokémon Red and Green Versions|Green]] version of Pokémon. Her [[first partner Pokémon]] was {{p|Squirtle}}. According to the bonus chapters of the manga, the hardest parts of the game for her were finding the Card Key in [[Silph Co.]] and fighting [[Lorelei]].

Her debut work was ''Crystal Change'', published in the March 1996 issue of [[Ciao]]. Her recent works include ''Stitch!'', a manga based on the title character from the {{wp|Disney}} film {{wp|Lilo & Stitch}}, and ''Fluffy, Fluffy Cinnamoroll'', based on the {{wp|Sanrio}} character {{wp|Cinnamoroll}}.

Tsukirino has won the 37th ''Shōgakukan Shinjin Komikku Taishō'' (Shogakukan Newcomer Manga Award) in the female division.
